description: Combat copy of the formation lab (game designer decisions 2026-11-01, docs/design/COMBAT_LAB.md; built by Scripts/Editor/build_formation_lab.py from Content/Data/FormationLab/Combat/formation_lab_combat_01.json = the lab layout + 4 towers with ladders). The squad meets endless enemy pressure: the first group at 30 s, then every 2 minutes a group of 1-3 (Hound, Frostbitten, Spitter, Cutter, Marksman) - a patrol walking a loop or ambushers hidden at wall ends / doorways / the authored ambush points near the squad's way that strike when their side is unwatched; some ambushes are coordinated plans of 4-6 (flanks first, then rear + front, ranged ones suppress; their own alive cap 6); a bypassed ambush relocates ahead unseen. Fights start on contact (combat_start ambush) as skirmishes and end straight in exploration. No cold, no intro briefing, no horde; the squad is immortal with infinite ammo by default (Codex.Cheat.Immortal / Codex.Cheat.InfiniteAmmo 0 turn them off). ONE small wave only because the level file must hold a valid wave (CodexTactics.LevelJson.AllFilesParse); it is never played (the fights are skirmishes).
